title: Make intents resume ergonomic
summary: Let `covenant intents resume` resolve the latest BudgetExhausted intent automatically, and add a live CLI test so the resume path stays regression-safe.
expectedFailureModes: `covenant intents resume latest` selects a BudgetExhausted row for a different peer, leaking intent text across auth boundaries.
The CLI picks a stale BudgetExhausted row when multiple are present, resuming the wrong intent without warning.
Resume behavior regresses silently because only IPC-level tests exist and the CLI subprocess path is untested.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_cli_intents_resume --locked -- --ignored live_
nextAction: Triage and implement `resume latest` resolution via RecentAudit scanning, add a live CLI integration test, and update status/docs to reflect the new ergonomic path.
